name: multimath
description: Core to create fast image math in WebAssembly and JS.

scripts.build:llvm: docker build -t multimath_llvm -f ./support/Dockerfile.llvm ./support && docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/src -u $(id -u):$(id -g) multimath_llvm ./support/compile-llvm.sh
scripts.coverage: npm run test && nyc report --reporter html
